name: forlife-com-platform
description: Forlife Com — AI Growth & Creative OS (modular monolith)

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @forlife/api && npm run build -w @forlife/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @forlife/api && npm run typecheck -w @forlife/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @forlife/shared && npm run test -w @forlife/api
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @forlife/api
